summary.summary:
Migrated pydantic_cli from pydantic 1 to pydantic 2 API. All 35 tests pass on pydantic 2.14.3.

Changes:
- pydantic_cli/__init__.py: replaced ModelField usage with FieldInfo from cls.model_fields. Added _get_field_type_info() to derive the inner type, Optional-ness and list/set shape from the annotation, since v2 no longer exposes type_/allow_none/shape. field.field_info.extra -> json_schema_extra (dict only), .description moved to FieldInfo directly, PydanticUndefined defaults map to None (or default_factory()). cls.__fields__ -> model_fields, cls.schema() keys -> model_fields keys, cls.validate() -> model_validate(), cli_config.copy() -> model_copy().
- pydantic_cli/core.py: CliConfig uses model_config = ConfigDict(validate_default=True, validate_assignment=True) instead of the v1 inner Config. _get_cli_config_from_model reads the user's nested Config via getattr(cls, "Config", None), so models without one (no longer an attribute on v2 BaseModel) still work.
- pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_enum_by_name.py: __get_validators__ (ignored by v2) replaced with __get_pydantic_core_schema__ wrapping the enum schema in a before-validator for case-insensitive lookup.
- REQUIREMENTS.txt: pydantic >= 2.0, < 3. No other companion pins were found in the repo.

Behaviour notes for review:
- Optional[T] fields without a default are no longer required on the CLI (default None), matching v1 and the example comments; the test suite depends on this for --outfile. Side effect: Optional[T] = Field(...) also loses required-ness on the CLI.
- Not migrated (still work, but deprecated in v2): the nested class Config mechanism for the CLI_* options and Field(cli=...)/Field(extra kwargs) in examples and README. Migrating them to model_config/json_schema_extra would be a follow-up with docs changes.
- setup.py still declares python_requires >=3.7 and 3.7-3.9 classifiers; current pydantic 2 releases require a newer Python, so this may need bumping.
- Pre-existing, not touched: in to_runner_sp, the _setup_hook builds c = cli_config.model_copy() but then passes cli_config to setup_hook_to_load_json.

- Fix the code under test, never the tests. Test files cannot be edited, and tests must not be skipped.
- Do a real migration to the pydantic 2 API. Do not route around it with compatibility shims that keep the old API alive (for Pydantic: no `pydantic.v1` imports).
- Update the dependency pin in the project metadata (pyproject.toml, setup.py/setup.cfg or requirements files) so it allows pydantic 2 and excludes versions the migrated code no longer supports. Also check the pins of companion packages that must move with it (for example web frameworks or plugins built on pydantic): their minimum must support pydantic 2.
- Work one root cause at a time, starting with the largest failure group. Read the code at the reported location before editing it. Prefer small, targeted edits.
- After related edits, re-run the affected tests to check them before moving on.
